translation: I thought that qi and blood all pass up and down through the neck, and without discussing the reason, I rubbed the neck to seek immediate relief, not knowing what was called the channels. Fortunately there was no great disease, and the middle of the neck also became loose and soft, only there was no way to remove it completely. Also, whenever I walked hurriedly, the chest and diaphragm made a sound like wood and stone colliding, the left flank was pulled and painful and I panted; in winter I coughed and spat phlegm, my ears and feet had chilblains, and soreness and pain arose between the waist and legs; all of this was because the accumulation had long spread and extended, but at that time I truly did not know it.
